shared_elements: horizontal rows of repeated linear marks
justification: The only real correspondences are generic schematic linear motifs: both surfaces include horizontal bands/rows with repeated short marks and some compartment-like divisions. The depicted content is otherwise very different: B shows two stacked long boats with upturned ends and crew/rib marks, while A shows a dense assemblage of animal-like and geometric relief figures on a vertical pillar with no clear boat scheme.
